info.title: gravc
info.description: gravc — CLI for the Gravity DSL. Validates, compiles, and runs reference emitters from .gravity sources. Install as a global tool: `dotnet tool install -g gravc`.

options.name: --plugin
options.description:
Additional emitter assembly (DLL) or directory containing
*.dll emitter assemblies. May be repeated.
